grains.RAW.FIELD_DAILY: one row per field per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.SENSOR_COVERAGE: one row per field (sensor mapping coverage snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.crop_stress_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(crop-stress event in next 7 days) per field, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day grower-wide crop harvest FORECAST; soil moisture deficit ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.AGRONOMY_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic crop-stress response SOPs (one per crop and cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.AGRONOMY_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.AGRONOMY_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, crop-stress, cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (fields with observations, daily plant health rate, crop-stress events by field, crop-stress risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
